verdict.rationale: Mangopay offers some background automation primitives. Event webhooks can be configured from the Dashboard to notify other applications. It also documents an integration that automates order processing and payouts for Mirakl marketplaces, and custom fraud-detection rules. These are platform-level automations rather than a user-configurable system for autonomous background workflows. Missing for 10: a general-purpose automation/workflow builder, scheduled or recurring job configuration, agent-driven autonomous execution, and independent corroboration.
